# Cnippet Scroll Reveal

Source: https://ui.cnippet.dev/r/scroll-reveal.json (retrieved 2026-10-11).
Author repository: https://github.com/cnippet-dev/ui-cnippet (MIT; LICENSE included).
Examples: https://ui.cnippet.dev/motion/scroll-animations/scroll-reveal

The product cards use the exact Feature Cards example variants, transition and viewport threshold. No custom motion curves or hover transforms.
Local adaptations: reduced-motion bypass as recommended in upstream docs; once marks completion only for the visible animation (prevents hidden completion revealing offscreen content).
